title: Seagrove Manor | KEY.co
description_expanded: Each bedroom offers a spacious, private retreat with spa-like bathrooms adorned with exquisite tile work. Unique design details add character and interest, including historical New Orleans brackets and doors, massive exposed beams on 12-foot ceilings, and reclaimed barn wood walls. The home also boasts a custom-built wine cellar and a rooftop deck with breathtaking sunset views of Eastern Lake and the Gulf of Mexico. With two complimentary paddleboards, guests can easily access the Gulf's sugar sands or enjoy fishing and sunsets from the private dock. Nestled in the esteemed Eastern Lake community, this home promises an unparalleled living experience where every detail is curated to elevate life's moments to their fullest potential. This custom five-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bath home on 30A perfectly marries classic beachfront charm with upscale sophistication. From the moment you enter the grand foyer, with its high ceilings and stunning staircase, you're drawn through the family room to a wall of windows revealing the pool deck and private dock. The gourmet kitchen, featuring an oversized island, custom cabinetry, and top-of-the-line appliances, is ideal for entertaining or hosting large family gatherings. Designed to embrace the panoramic water views, every level of the home seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor living, with a tonal palette and tactile textures that create a cohesive and inviting atmosphere.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 4: Queen + Single Over Single Bunk
Bedroom 5: Two Single Over Single Bunks
